whatIs: RGE Studio is a collaborative editor for building HTML emails, made by Really Good Emails, which is part of Beefree and uses its editing technology. It offers a library of more than 1,250 editable, mobile-friendly templates, an AI assistant for generating drafts, and export to sending platforms and CRMs.
It's a good fit when you need to build polished newsletters or transactional emails without writing the HTML by hand, and when several people need to comment on and approve the designs.
uses: Laying out a product's welcome email starting from a template and exporting the HTML.
Having the marketing team review and approve a design inside the editor before exporting it.
Locking in brand styles so other people on the team don't stray from the design.
caveats: The free plan is limited to 10 designs and 6 exports per month.
Advanced brand controls, built-in approvals and the quality assistant are on the Business and Enterprise plans.
Professional costs $30 per month billed monthly or $25 per month billed annually, and includes 2 users; each extra seat is paid separately.
pricingNote: The Starter plan is free; Professional starts at $25 per month (billed annually), and there are Business and Enterprise plans.
idealFor: Teams that design HTML emails and need templates and approvals.
